preview.synopsis: First-ever meeting between the sides. Basaksehir are slightly better placed after Corum's heavy defeat. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Ninth on 17 points (19-17), won 2-1 at Goztepe, three wins in last five; Fayzullaev and Operi doubts, Sengezer out.
strengths.away: 11th on 16 points (21-21), lost 0-5 at home to Fenerbahce; three wins in last five.

preview.synopsis: Midtjylland are the stronger side on form and table position; Brondby have won one of the last five meetings. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Fifth on 22 points (23-21), lost 0-1 at Copenhagen; best big-chance conversion in the league but poor shot accuracy; Binks and Kohlert out.
strengths.away: Second on 32 points (29-17), drew 2-2 with Sonderjyske, four wins and a draw in last five; Martinez and Bakker out.

preview.synopsis: Hammarby hold the clear form and attacking edge and have won four of the last five meetings. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Second on 58 points (60-23), five straight wins, 4-1 over Elfsborg; xG 2.02 per match; Boudri and Hagen out, Heintz suspended.
strengths.away: 10th on 39 points (36-46), five without a win after 0-0 with Malmo; xG 1.41.

preview.synopsis: Bottom-end Allsvenskan match; Kalmar slightly better placed and have won their recent meetings. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

preview.author: Tomáš Vlasák

pick.text: Monza’s matches have regularly been high-scoring affairs at both ends, while Fiorentina have tended to come alive after the break, making over 2.5 goals and both teams to score the standout play.

preview.synopsis: Monza beat Fiorentina twice in seven meetings this century and six of those seven saw both sides score. Writer picks over 2.5 goals and both teams to score (no outcome covered).

strengths.home: Promoted side in the relegation zone after four straight league losses (1-0 at Atalanta); 25 goals conceded; three wins in 24 home Serie A games.
strengths.away: Arthur Atta and Marin Pongracic out; tend to come alive after the break.

preview.author: Ryan Fisher

pick.text: With both sides struggling in attack, under 2.5 goals looks a smart approach.

preview.synopsis: Valencian derby between two sides short of goals; Levante have won two of the last three league H2Hs. Writer picks under 2.5 goals.

strengths.home: One win in last nine La Liga games, one goal in a three-game winless run; lost the last four Valencian derbies.
strengths.away: Struggling in attack too; few wins in recent head-to-heads.

preview.author: Chris Wilson

pick.text: It remains to be seen whether Everton’s last away win was a flash in the pan or not, so backing a draw seems a safer approach to take.

preview.synopsis: Brentford winless in their last four home league H2Hs with Everton. Writer backs a draw.

strengths.home: One win in five Premier League games, 2-0 loss to Brighton; Igor Thiago suspended, Collins injured on international duty; won four of last seven at home.
strengths.away: Recently won away, unclear if a flash in the pan.

preview.synopsis: MLS Cup Round 1; recent meetings average 2.6 goals and St. Louis won one of the last five. AI stats preview, no writer's pick.

strengths.home: Third in the West with 54 points (59-48), one win in last five; best big-chance conversion in the league; Holse out, Burki and Shaffelburg doubts.
strengths.away: Sixth in the West with 47 points (52-40), nine-match winless run away from home.
